verdict.rationale: Docs mention enrichment only as an example built via custom Workflows (HTTP request to an external API) and via AI Agents that can 'enrich records with data from external sources,' but there's no evidence of a built-in, native firmographic/contact enrichment provider or one-click integration—it requires the ops user (or a dev) to configure a workflow or agent with a third-party data source. Missing for 10: a native/pre-built enrichment integration (e.g., built-in data provider), independent/hands-on confirmation that enrichment works as advertised, and detail on what firmographic data fields are actually populated.
